checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Fox matches mascot's face, markings, proportions
must.why: Face, ears, tail and markings are consistent; the bike fox's body is a bit stylized and the faces are slightly more realistic, but it is clearly the same character.
The hoodie is visible in all three.

must.item: Bike in park, baking cookies in kitchen, reading under tree
must.why: All three scenes match the request.
Cartoon outlines with some shading and gradients in the kitchen and bike scenes; no text.

faults.what: The bike scene has slightly muddled legs and a fox head with a more realistic muzzle than the reference; the shading is a little less flat.
The reading scene has a plain white background in the lower half, so the scene looks unfinished.
The kitchen fox is holding the tray with one hand and has no visible second arm.

summary: Three separate, consistent fox pictures matching all three requested scenes, with only minor flaws such as slight style drift and a blank white background in the reading picture.
